personality: 7 Dark-First Utility with 6 Glass / Luxe premium surfacing
personality_one_liner: A high-end, tactile command center that turns personal inventory into liquid cash with surgical precision and cinematic elegance.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing. Allow the dark canvas to breathe. Group metrics tightly, but pad outer containers substantially.

do's: Use blur/glass heavily on the bottom tab bar, sticky headers, and bottom-sheet handles.
Apply glassmorphism to hero cards overlaying background photos.
dont's: Do not apply glass to body text containers or standard input fields.
Avoid stacking more than 2 glass layers.

screens.name: Accueil
screens.purpose: Provide a high-level overview of the user's potential resale portfolio and prompt immediate action.

states.empty: Abstract minimalist architecture photo with a message encouraging the user to scan their first item.
states.error: Message with a clear retry button.

screens.layout: Top section: Greeting and a massive 'Vos gains potentiels' metric using Space Grotesk. Center: A large, glass-morphic CTA card prompting 'Scanner un objet' with an electric lime accent. Bottom: A horizontally scrolling list of 'Objets récents' with image thumbnails and estimated prices.

screens.name: Scanner
screens.purpose: A cinematic camera flow that analyzes an item and instantly generates its resale value.

states.error: Camera access denied, fallback to manual entry or photo picker.

screens.layout: Phase 1: Full-bleed camera view with tactical framing brackets and a floating shutter button. Phase 2: Analyzing animation (dark overlay, glowing lime scanline, 'Analyse en cours...'). Phase 3: Results sheet popping up. Shows Item Name, Condition (color-coded tag), and 3 selectable Price Strategies ('Vente rapide', 'Prix intelligent', 'Prix maximum') using stacked cards.

screens.name: Détail de l'objet
screens.purpose: Deep dive into an analyzed item, showcasing its sell score and the AI-generated marketplace listing.

states.loading: Spinner centered on a dark canvas.

screens.layout: Hero: Edge-to-edge photo of the item with a vertical gradient-to-dark scrim. Overlaid: Title and a circular 'Sell Score' ring (0-100) in electric lime. Body: AI Photo Coach tips. Below: An editable 'Listing Generator' section (Title, Description, Keywords) presented as high-contrast input fields on surfaceSecondary. Fixed bottom CTA to 'Publier l'annonce'.

screens.name: Mes objets
screens.purpose: Manage and track all scanned inventory and their current sales status.

states.empty: A stylish empty state illustration with 'Votre inventaire est vide'.

screens.layout: A vertical list view. Each row features a square thumbnail, title, category, estimated price in large font, and a status pill (e.g., 'Brouillon', 'Prêt à vendre'). The list sits on the main dark canvas, separated by subtle 1px dividers.

screens.name: Profil
screens.purpose: Review overall performance and account settings.
screens.layout: Header: User avatar and name. Top section: 3-column stats grid (Total gagné, Objets vendus, Prix moyen) using large Space Grotesk numbers. Below: Settings and preferences list inside a grouped rounded container.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the Dark-First Utility mixed with Glass / Luxe personality. The entire app must be dark-themed with `#0A0A0A` as the main background.
Use Space Grotesk for all primary numerical values, prices, and main headers. Use Geist for secondary text and descriptions.

Prominently feature the electric lime (`#D4FF3F`) accent color for the main 'Scanner' CTA, the Sell Score ring, and active tab indicators. Do not overuse it elsewhere; keep it as a surgical highlight.
In the 'Scanner' flow, implement an engaging analyzing animation (e.g., a glowing lime scanline traversing the screen) before revealing the results sheet.
Ensure all text rendered on top of imagery uses the gradient-to-dark scrim pattern (top-to-bottom vertical linear gradient with stops transparent -> 20% surfaceInverse -> 70% surfaceInverse).
Implement bottom sheet navigation pattern for presenting the 3 selling strategies (Vente rapide, Prix intelligent, Prix maximum) immediately after a successful scan.
Use French consistently across the interface ('Vos gains potentiels', 'Mes objets', 'Vente rapide').
